name: Meridian Solutions
tagline: A solutions agency, built from scratch.
description: Meridian Solutions is a custom software and digital agency operating on a middleman/freelancer model. Services include custom software, SaaS, MVPs, ecommerce, websites/WordPress, hosting, and tech consultations. The platform features a marketing website, client portal, and admin system built on Supabase with full CRUD dashboards, Paystack payments, referral commissions, Resend emails, and Cloudflare Turnstile.
